say: Send a one-page proposal within two working days of your call. Start with her situation, in her own words from your BANT notes.

say: A single price makes the client decide yes or no. Two or three options make her decide which one, and your rate stays the same.

say: Ask for a deposit before you spend money or much time. Many providers ask 30% to 50%.
Bisi confirmed the transfer in her own banking app before buying ingredients. Never rely on a screenshot or SMS alert, because both can be faked.
Send a written confirmation of the scope, price and dates, and ask the client to reply 'Confirmed'. If she later asks you to 'just do our logo', kindly send a separate price.

panel.heading: Before you start the work

Confirmed in your own banking app
Receipt with amount, date and balance
Client replies 'Confirmed' in writing

say: Most happy clients never refer anyone unless you ask. Ask when she has just seen a result.

panel.heading: Ask for a referral the right way
items: Ask right after a visible result
Thank her and mention the result
Ask a specific question
Offer a message she can forward
Thank her again, whatever happens

say: A case study is a short, true story of one job. For example, Halima asked permission, then described a 250-pupil school in Kaduna with an inactive Facebook page.

panel.heading: Halima's honest case study
items: Problem: inactive page, fewer enquiries
Did: 12 posts in 4 weeks, 2 flyers
Result: enquiries rose from 9 to 23
Honest note: admissions season helped too
